title: David’s Instructions and Death

questions.question: What was David's charge to Solomon regarding the Law of Moses?
options: Keep the charge of the Lord, walking in his ways
questions.correctAnswer: Keep the charge of the Lord, walking in his ways
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:3 (ESV): "and keep the charge of the LORD your God, walking in his ways and keeping his statutes..."

questions.question: Who asked Solomon for Abishag the Shunammite as a wife?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:17 (ESV): "He said, 'Please ask King Solomon... to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.'"

questions.question: What happened to Adonijah as a result of his request?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:24-25 (ESV): "...Adonijah shall be put to death this day. So King Solomon sent Benaiah... and he struck him down..."

questions.question: Who did Solomon command to strike down Joab?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:29-34 (ESV): "...Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, 'Go, strike him down.'"

questions.question: How long did David reign over Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:11 (ESV): "The time that David reigned over Israel was forty years..."

questions.question: Why did David advise Solomon to deal with Joab?
options: Because he killed Abner and Amasa in peacetime
questions.correctAnswer: Because he killed Abner and Amasa in peacetime
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:5 (ESV): "Moreover, you also know what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, how he dealt with the two commanders... whom he killed... avenging in time of peace for blood that had been shed in war."

questions.question: To whom did David want Solomon to show kindness?
options: The sons of Barzillai the Gileadite
questions.correctAnswer: The sons of Barzillai the Gileadite
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:7 (ESV): "But deal loyally with the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table..."

questions.question: Where was Joab when he was killed?
options: Holding the horns of the altar
questions.correctAnswer: Holding the horns of the altar
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:28 (ESV): "Joab fled to the tent of the LORD and caught hold of the horns of the altar."

questions.question: What restriction did Solomon place on Shimei?
options: Do not cross the brook Kidron
questions.correctAnswer: Do not cross the brook Kidron
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:37 (ESV): "For on the day you go out and cross the brook Kidron, know for certain that you shall die..."

questions.question: Why did Shimei eventually leave Jerusalem, leading to his death?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:39-40 (ESV): "But it happened at the end of three years that two of Shimei's servants ran away to Achish... So Shimei arose... and went to Gath to seek his servants."

questions.question: Who replaced Abiathar as priest?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:35 (ESV): "...and Zadok the priest the king put in the place of Abiathar."

questions.question: Who replaced Joab as commander of the army?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:35 (ESV): "The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the army in place of Joab..."

questions.question: Why was Abiathar spared from death?
options: Because he bore the ark and shared David's afflictions
questions.correctAnswer: Because he bore the ark and shared David's afflictions
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:26 (ESV): "...for you deserve death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father..."

questions.question: Where was David buried?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:10 (ESV): "Then David slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David."

questions.question: What phrase describes Solomon's established rule at the end of the chapter?
options: The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon
questions.correctAnswer: The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:46 (ESV): "...So the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon."

key_verse_text: I am about to go the way of all the earth. Be strong, and show yourself a man, (ESV)
